files.description: Product returns in March (80 rows): return_id (whole number), quantity (whole number), refund (two decimals). Same columns as returns_april.csv.
Product returns in April: the header row (return_id, quantity, refund, as in returns_march.csv) and no data rows, because nothing was returned in April.

task_text: Combine the March and April returns and give the 10th, 50th and 90th percentiles of the refund amounts. `result` should be a table indexed by the three percentile levels (0.1, 0.5, 0.9) with a column refund.
intended_computation: Percentiles (linear interpolation) of the 80 refunds of both months at 0.1, 0.5 and 0.9, as a one-column table indexed by the level.

acceptable_variants.notes: the percentiles may follow any standard quantile definition (linear, lower, higher, nearest, midpoint)

predicted_direction.reason: quantile(numeric_only=True) on the combined table kept the numeric refund column on 2.x; on 3.x no column is numeric after concat with the empty table and the result has no columns.
